title: LWM-CDE: A Representation Space for Wireless Data Reasoning and Transferability
method_summary: Frozen channel embeddings plus label-aware sliced Wasserstein/centroid distances rank source datasets; optional metric refinement uses measured transfer rankings.
adoption_limits: Refined metric fails transfer from sub6 to28GHz in the paper; no universal drift/SLA guarantee. Refined paper checkpoints are explicitly absent from release; standalone weight rights and data dependencies need separate verification.
